summary: Website branding/content updates for “Falcon IDs,” including removal of role-play/novelty/cosplay disclaimer language and replacing the logo with Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” branding across the site.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Gothic-style wordmark reading “Falcon IDs”, transparent background (falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png)
- Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” favicon, high-contrast, legible at small sizes (falcon-ids-favicon-gothic.dim_32x32.png)
- Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” apple touch icon, centered with padding (falcon-ids-apple-touch-gothic.dim_180x180.png)

existing_features.title: Remove all references to role-play, props, novelty use, and cosplay from all user-facing warnings, disclaimers, and page copy across the site, rewriting the remaining copy so it reads realistic and professional while keeping a concise legality/validity notice where appropriate.
Replace the current logo everywhere with a Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” wordmark, including the header, landing page hero, footer branded areas (if any), and any other visible branded placements.
Update site icons to match the new Gothic “Falcon IDs” branding by replacing the favicon and apple-touch icon references in frontend/index.html with the new branded assets.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove all references to role-play, props, novelty use, or cosplay from warnings, disclaimers, and page text to make the brand feel realistic and professional
Replace the current logo everywhere with Gothic-style lettering that says “Falcon IDs” in the header, footer, favicon, and all branded areas
Add a main-page support/ticket section where customers can submit tickets and admins can respond
Create a helper feature called “Falcon” for answering customer questions with admin response capability
Improve code for speed/performance and overall user satisfaction (general optimization pass)
